description: Found by the fz-kdt.104 cold review's prototype (2026-08-31): with canonical clause order in place, FIFO+sort vs LIFO+sort on enum_predicate_search still differ 221 vs 207 executables -- 14 FIFO-only specializations on over-wide inputs (int | :false | :ok | :true). Covered by neither fz-kdt.101 (display) nor fz-kdt.104/105 (dispatch/keys). Diagnose after 104+105 land: is this the fz-kdt.63-noted return-widening ladder shape, or demand issued from mid-ascent evidence that later narrows? title: 14 FIFO-only over-wide specializations on enum_predicate_search: schedule-dependent demand of transient wide joins
